caption: probabilities() only reads self.alpha/self.beta — it never changes the qubit's state.

code:
def apply_gate(self, gate):
  state = np.array([self.alpha, self.beta])
  new = gate @ state
  return Qubit(new[0], new[1])

q = Qubit(0.6, 0.8)
print(q.probabilities())  # (0.36, 0.64)
print(q)  # Qubit(alpha=0.6000, beta=0.8000)
caption: Returning a new Qubit instead of mutating self keeps every intermediate state inspectable.
